text:
maria: heads-up: VoltEdge sent a kernel patch for the A7 board. want to run a concise joint perf sweep (perf/W + p99) before we publish the marketplace entry. who wants to own the runbook?

akash: i can own orchestration. propose scope: gpt-small/med/large + embedder, batch sizes 8/16/32, short/long seq.

lin: add a 1h steady-state soak at target qps to catch thermal/psu behavior. also ensure identical tokenization across runs.

sofia (VoltEdge): we'll provide patched kernel, prometheus exporters, and sensor mapping. exposing power rails + board temps via i2c. helper script forthcoming.

maria: deliverables: run plan, infra scripts, reproducible nomad job, golden charts (perf/W + p99), and a short co-announce blurb. timelines?

akash: rough timeline: day0 infra prep + kernel deploy, day1 smoke, day2 full sweep, day3 analysis + charts. 4 working days.

lin: require checksum guardrails for model binaries and promptset v0.3. abort on mismatch.

sofia (VoltEdge): sensor map: VE_A7_PWR0 -> i2c:1:0x40, VE_A7_TEMP0 -> i2c:1:0x41. we'll push exporters + creds by EOD.

maria: kernel tuning: run default and latency-optimized (irq + scheduler tweaks). if latency profile hurts perf/W, mark it.

akash: encoding knobs as per-node JSON configs, example: {"profile":"latency-optimized","irq_balance":"on","cpu_gov":"performance","scheduler_tune":"latency_hint"} (we'll store in repo).

lin: include KV cache hit rate and per-token emit timing. benchbot, add kv_cache_hit_pct and emit_time_per_token_ms to exports.

benchbot: template metrics added: [power_watts,total_tokens,p99_latency_ms,kv_cache_hit_pct,emit_time_per_token_ms,board_temp_c]. export prefix: voltedge_a7_run_<ts>.csv

maria: sofia, raw traces ok to share to partnership bucket with ACLs? we only publish aggregated charts.

sofia (VoltEdge): yes. uploading to s3://ve-partner-shared/redwood-inference/voltedge-a7/1745559999/ with cross-org read ACL. will DM creds.

akash: infra blocker: need dedicated bench nodegroup (2x A7) + control host. lin, can you provision k3s nodes and nomad job?

lin: will create nodegroup and nomad job spec. posted job link: https://internal.redwood/workspaces/benching/nomad/jobs/voltedge-a7-run. review appreciated.

maria: scheduling: 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to walk checklist and confirm sign-offs. invite incoming.

sofia (VoltEdge): 10:30 PT works. excited to see the perf/W results :rocket:

akash: actions: akash: runbook + nomad templates (+1d), lin: provisioning + checksum test (+1d), sofia: push kernel + exporters + creds (today), maria: draft co-announce blurb (+3d).

maria: call out infra noise (thermal/psu) immediately in thread.

sofia (VoltEdge): will include PSU serials in metadata for traceability. :white_check_mark:

akash: posting runbook draft soon.

maria: thanks everyone, closing until the 10:30 sync.
